name: @bytechef/app-workspace
description: Workspace for the ByteChef App SDK (@bytechef/app) development

scripts.check:all: cd library && npm run check && cd .. && npm run test:create
scripts.publish:library: cd library && npm run build && npm run publish:local
scripts.clean: rm -rf library/dist library/node_modules test-app/dist test-app/.output test-app/node_modules verdaccio-storage
scripts.check:test-app: cd test-app && npm run build && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs
